name: visumo Inc.
summary: visumo Inc. develops and operates marketing platforms, including a SaaS visual marketing platform that gathers hashtagged photos from Instagram and other social media for use as website content. Clients come from apparel, beauty, interior, food, tourism and local government sectors. It dates from 2019, has its base in Shibuya, Japan, and is a subsidiary of Softcreate Holdings Corp.
